note: Beta store. The `price` here is the single source of truth: it is what the page shows AND what Stripe charges, so the two can never drift. `stripeProductId` is the item's Stripe product (prod_...), created once in Stripe with no price attached. `shipped` marks items that need a postal address; a basket of downloads only skips shipping entirely. A product with no stripeProductId cannot be bought. See docs/store-setup.md.
